from pwn import *

HOST = "34.234.204.29"
PORT = 39079

# Logging setup to save everything
context.log_level = 'debug'

io = remote(HOST, PORT)

# Receive banner/initial text
try:
    init_data = io.recv(timeout=5)
    print("[Banner/Init]:", init_data)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"[!] Exception in receiving init: {e}")
    init_data = b''

# Try sending a blank line
try:
    io.sendline(b"")
    blank_response = io.recv(timeout=3)
    print("[Blank Line Response]:", blank_response)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"[!] Exception in blank line: {e}")
    blank_response = b''

    io.sendline(b"testinput")
    test_response = io.recv(timeout=3)
    print("[ASCII testinput Response]:", test_response)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"[!] Exception in testinput: {e}")
    test_response = b''

# Try sending '/etc/passwd\n' in case of filename handling
try:
    io.sendline(b"/etc/passwd")
    passwd_response = io.recv(timeout=3)
    print("[/etc/passwd Response]:", passwd_response)
except Exception as e:

    passwd_response = b''

    print("[flag.txt Response]:", flagtxt_response)

    print(f"[!] Exception in flag.txt: {e}")
    flagtxt_response = b''

    f.write(b"[/etc/passwd Response]:\n" + passwd_response + b"\n")
